name: oscar-claude-mods
description: Oscar's personal Claude Code mods, for general use across projects

plugins.name: og-sf-org-status
plugins.description: Status line with the project's target Salesforce org, and a write guard for protected and production orgs

plugins.name: og-focus-mode
plugins.description: Focus mode: a cleaner terminal interface, toggled with /og-focus

plugins.name: og-themes
plugins.description: Neocol and LaGana Lion themes (dark and light), picked per project with /og-theme and switched live

plugins.name: og-ticket
plugins.description: The work item in focus (an ID and a description) on the status line, set with /og-ticket or by Claude

plugins.name: og-copy
plugins.description: Copy Claude's responses as clean Markdown, in full or block by block (/og-copy), or a part Claude picks (og_copy tool)

plugins.name: og-sf-soql
plugins.description: SOQL results as a table in a pane: Claude's sf data query runs and your own /og-soql queries, with record view and Markdown/CSV copy
